appended.name: Smith & Nephew plc
appended.suggestion: Mandatory annual+interim summarize_filing_body plus news+screen+gap consumes the five-task cap on two product RNSs that are not results. There is no type or period flag for trading_update, 20-F, rns_cluster (PDMR/buyback/TVR), or “catalog_period_mismatch”. gap_inventory can only list that the Q1 TU — the only indexed financial body — and the unpublished H1 RNS were dropped. appended.name: Smith & Nephew plc
appended.suggestion: weeks_at_signal=9 / stable / conviction 0.93 looks like a settled Strong Buy, but there is no watch schema for: ingest of the Aug 2026 H1/Q2 RNS (news-visible, catalog-absent), FY2026 guidance vs Q2 1.6%, US knee / skin-substitute run-rate, CFO successor and Cevian 14.21%, remaining buyback vs £1,039/£997 ladder, ADS 52-week low vs LSE print, or post-4 Sep RNS. News freshness reaches 4 Sep; filings_index fetched 17:25Z the same day still lacks the August results body — a same-day coverage hole, not a stale-data hole.

appended.name: Smith & Nephew plc
appended.suggestion: A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend Yahoo USD statutory with company trading-profit/FCF and will not force Orthopaedics vs Sports Med & ENT vs Advanced Wound Management, US knees vs rest-of-world, skin-substitute reimbursement, FCF 1,059m vs 852m, ADS vs LSE price, or an explicit PRIMARY-FILING GAP box.
